'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Kevin Shannon DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet name field '''Shannon'''; username '''rejvor'''; dest [[Kevin Shannon]]. Joke annotations on sheet (e.g. Imperial City spelling, Black Leader note) normalized to card titles.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) (Virtual Block 2)|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)]]
* '''Username:''' rejvor
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
